subject: chemistry
content: Iodine molecule dissociates into atoms after absorbing light of 4500 Å. If one quantum of radiation is absorbed by each molecule, calculate the kinetic energy of iodine atoms. (Bond energy of I<sub>2</sub> = 240 kJ mol<sup>-1</sup>)
